+## 7. Real Baseline Activation & Automated Monitoring Worker Discovery
+
+### Pipeline Architecture: Baseline Candidate to Automated Monitoring
+The transition follows strict unidirectional progression:
+```
+PROCESSED REAL BASELINE
+        ↓
+EXPLICIT BASELINE ACTIVATION (BaselineService.activateBaseline with 14-point safety gate)
+        ↓
+ACTIVE BASELINE (isActive: true, status: ACTIVE, exactly 1 active optical baseline per zone)
+        ↓
+ZONE ELIGIBLE FOR AUTOMATED MONITORING (GET /api/monitoring/areas returns ACTIVE/ELIGIBLE)
+        ↓
+MONITORING WORKER DISCOVERS ZONE (MonitoringSchedulerWorker queries zone with active baseline)
+        ↓
+CANDIDATE SELECTION & PRECEDENCE CHECK (Rejects baseline image itself; awaits strictly newer observations)
+        ↓
+BASELINE IMMUTABILITY VERIFIED (activeBaselineId remains strictly unchanged)
+```
+
+### 1. Database State & Connection Semantics
+- **Connection Semantics**: If MongoDB is disconnected (`readyState !== 1`), services explicitly return/throw `DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE` (HTTP 503) rather than silently returning empty arrays or reporting 0 active zones. When connected, `DATABASE_CONNECTED` is logged with active zone counts.
+- **Zone Schema Integration**: Zone records using `ZoneStatus.PROTECTED` are recognized alongside `ACTIVE` across `MonitoringSchedulerWorker`, `AutomatedMonitoringService`, and `MonitoringSchedulerService`.
+
+### 2. 14-Point Pipeline Gate Audit on Sathiyar Baseline

+- `GET /api/monitoring/areas`: Sathiyar Reserve Forest is returned with status `ACTIVE`, reporting:
